prompts: The investors meet tomorrow and want the first half of 2026 closed. The books and the board's notes are in {WS}/finance. How did each month go, and how many months of cash do we have left at the current burn? Prepare what the CFO needs to present. Record the key figures in {WS}/result.json: revenue, gross_margin_pct and ebitda, each mapping 2026-01 to 2026-06 to its value, plus burn and runway_months.
answers:
**[goal]** H1-2026 monthly P&L view + burn/runway for the investor meeting, recorded in `./result.json`.

**[action]** Parsed `finance/ledger.csv` (86 entries, pt-BR amounts) against `finance/chart_of_accounts.csv`; applied the board rules in `finance/README.md`: burn = average negative EBITDA of the last three closed months (Apr–Jun), runway = 30/06 closing cash (R$ 1,847,350.40 from `cash_balance.txt`) ÷ burn. Assumptions I made: revenue is net (account 3.1.09 refunds/cancellations is negative and already included in the revenue line); EBITDA = revenue + cogs + sales_marketing + rnd + ga + financial (investment income and interest included, as the ledger's only other lines); gross margin = (revenue + cogs) / revenue.

**[result]**

| Month | Revenue (R$) | Gross margin | EBITDA (R$) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Jan | 200,510.87 | 70.0% | -203,812.19 |
| Feb | 216,328.06 | 70.3% | -205,001.69 |
| Mar | 219,066.17 | 68.5% | -198,078.94 |
| Apr | 238,163.26 | 70.2% | -189,670.28 |
| May | 243,032.89 | 69.6% | -195,444.78 |
| Jun | 272,391.57 | 72.4% | -187,346.57 |

- **Burn: R$ 190,820.54/month** (avg of Apr–Jun losses). Runway: **9.7 months** from 30/06 cash of R$ 1,847,350.40.
- Story for the CFO: revenue grew +36% Jan→Jun with gross margin stable ~70% (dipping to 68.5% in March, best in June at 72.4%); EBITDA loss narrowed from ~R$ 205k to ~R$ 187k — growth is outpacing cost growth, burn is slowly improving, roughly 10 months of cash.

**Why it's right:** every figure is recomputed from the raw ledger by account → pnl_line mapping; monthly sums tie to the per-line totals I printed and cross-checked; cash figure taken verbatim from `cash_balance.txt` (30/06: R$ 1,847,350.40); burn/runway follow exactly the formula stated in `finance/README.md`. Caveats: the ledger's 3.1.09 "refunds" line is negative revenue (netted in), and no January opening cash was provided, so runway uses only the 30/06 balance as the README instructs.
